new_hand_theorem.name: dual-certificate barrier
new_hand_theorem.statement: If surviving-warrant existence is NP-complete and every no-surviving-warrant instance has a polynomial-size polynomial-time checkable noninteractive extinction certificate, then NP=coNP.
